name: Fenn Modea
source:
The Devious Libertine

Prince of Luxure. This sly, enticing prince is a master of seduction. People of all genders and ages succumb to his wiles, but none have ever truly touched his heart. Will you be the one to see the man that hides behind a veil of sin?

Indulgence: White Sangria
Pastime: Discovering new turn-ons

[From the English app "Court of Darkness"]
